এস,আর,ও নং ১৯৫-আইন/২০১০/২৩১৩/শুল্ক।— Customs Act, 1969 (Act IV of 1969) এর section 219, উক্ত Act এর Third Schedule এর Item 17 এর সহিত পঠিতব্য, এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, যাত্রী (অপর্যটক) ব্যাগেজ (আমদানি) বিধিমালা, ২০০৯ বাতিলক্রমে, নিম্নরূপ বিধিমালা প্রণয়ন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: Section 219 of this Act, read in conjunction with Item 17 of the Third Schedule, provides the legal authority for the National Board of Revenue to formulate customs rules.
Third Schedule: Item 17 of this schedule is cited as part of the legal basis for the National Board of Revenue's rule-making authority under the Customs Act 1969.
Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import): These existing rules are officially repealed and replaced by the newly formulated rules issued by the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is empowered by the Customs Act 1969 to enact and repeal rules governing the importation of passenger baggage.

Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import): These rules are officially titled the Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import) Rules 2010.
Passenger Baggage: These rules apply to all passengers except those who are covered under the separate Tourist Baggage (Import) Rules 1981 and the Privileged Persons (Customs Procedures) Rules 2003.
Tourist Baggage (Import) Rules 1981: These specific rules define a category of passengers that are explicitly excluded from the scope of the Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import) Rules 2010.
Privileged Persons (Customs Procedures): These rules define a specific class of passengers that fall outside the jurisdiction of the Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import) Rules 2010.

Baggage: Baggage is defined as a reasonable quantity of food items, apparel, household goods, or other personal effects imported by a passenger.
Passenger: A passenger is defined as any person arriving from abroad.
Schedule: A schedule is defined as any schedule attached to these rules.

(১১) ১২ (বার) বৎসরের কম বয়সের যাত্রী বিধি-৩ এর উপ-বিধি (৩) এ উল্লিখিত সুবিধা ব্যতীত অন্য কোন সুবিধা পাইবেনা।

Passenger Baggage: Passengers arriving by air or water are granted duty-free clearance for personal baggage within specified weight, dimension, and quantity limits. Separate allowances are provided for adult passengers and those under twelve years of age.
Specific baggage items, including personal effects and professional equipment, are exempted from customs duties and taxes subject to compliance with defined rules and weight thresholds.
Passengers may import unaccompanied baggage by providing a formal declaration and meeting all established regulatory requirements for clearance.
Baggage Declaration: For unaccompanied baggage, passengers must submit a formal declaration using the specified form to be eligible for duty-free clearance. A copy of this declaration must be provided to the customs officer at the time of clearing the goods.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: Certain specified electronic, household, and precious metal items are subject to specific customs duties and taxes upon import by passengers, as outlined in the provided schedule. Passengers are entitled to import these items upon payment of the prescribed duty amounts.
Bona Fide Baggage: Foreign nationals are permitted to import a limited quantity of alcoholic beverages for personal use free of customs duty and tax. Passengers may also import professional equipment that is portable and intended for use in their occupation without payment of duties.
Duty-Free Allowance: Passengers have the option to purchase designated household and electronic goods from designated sales centers within a specific timeframe after arrival in lieu of bringing them from abroad. Such purchases are processed under specific regulatory schedules and forms.

processed_clauses.clause_title: স্থল পথে আগত যাত্রীর জন্য সুবিধা
processed_clauses.resolved_text: ৪। স্থল পথে আগত যাত্রীর জন্য সুবিধা।— বিদেশে অবস্থানের মেয়াদ নির্বিশেষে স্থলপথে আগত একজন যাত্রী সর্বোচ্চ ৩০০ (তিন শত) মার্কিন ডলার মূল্যের ব্যাগেজ সকল প্রকার শুল্ক ও কর পরিশোধ ব্যতিরেকে আমদানি করিতে পারিবেন।

Passenger Baggage Allowance: Passengers arriving via land routes are permitted to import baggage free of customs duties and taxes up to a specified maximum value, regardless of the duration of their stay abroad.

processed_clauses.clause_title: অসুস্থ ও পঙ্গু যাত্রীর জন্য সুবিধা
processed_clauses.resolved_text: ৫। অসুস্থ ও পঙ্গু যাত্রীর জন্য সুবিধা।— আকাশ, জলপথ বা স্থলপথে আগত একজন অসুস্থ, পঙ্গু অথবা বৃদ্ধ যাত্রীর ব্যবহার্য চিকিৎসা যন্ত্রপাতি ও হুইল চেয়ার সকল প্রকার শুল্ক ও কর পরিশোধ ব্যতিরেকে খালাস করা যাইবে।

Passenger Baggage Allowance: Sick, disabled, or elderly passengers arriving by air, sea, or land are permitted to import their essential medical equipment and wheelchairs free of all duties and taxes.
This exemption is granted to facilitate the movement of essential assistive devices for passengers requiring specific medical or physical support.

Airline Crew Baggage Allowance: Airline crew and officers returning from abroad are permitted to import baggage up to a specified maximum value free of all duties and taxes.
Ship Crew Baggage Allowance: Bangladeshi ship crew and officers arriving from foreign ports are permitted to import baggage up to a specified maximum value free of all duties and taxes.
Ship crew and officers who have signed off from duty are permitted to import baggage up to a higher specified maximum value upon payment of all applicable duties and taxes.
Transport Crew Baggage Allowance: Drivers and stewards of international passenger buses are permitted to import personal items such as clothing, bedding, and cooked food, along with additional personal and household goods up to a specified maximum value, free of all duties and taxes.

(২) উপ-বিধি (১) এ যাহা কিছুই থাকুক না কেন, কোন শুল্ক কর্মকর্তা, যুক্তিসংগত সন্দেহেবশতঃ গ্রীন চ্যানেল অতিক্রমকারী যে কোন যাত্রীর ব্যাগেজ পরীক্ষা করিতে পারিবেন।

Green Channel: Passengers who are not carrying any goods liable for customs duty or taxes are permitted to use the Green Channel at the airport.
Customs officers reserve the right to inspect the baggage of any passenger using the Green Channel if there is a reasonable suspicion.
Red Channel: The Red Channel is designated for passengers who are carrying goods that may be subject to customs duty or tax assessments upon arrival.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: A customs officer has the authority to conduct an examination of any passenger's baggage passing through the Green Channel if they have reasonable grounds for suspicion.

Baggage Declaration: All passengers arriving from abroad must submit a baggage declaration by completing the form prescribed in the first schedule to the customs authority.
In cases of unaccompanied baggage, the declaration must be submitted by completing the prescribed form before leaving the customs hall or customs area.

If a declaration cannot be filed due to inadvertent errors or unavoidable circumstances, passengers may submit the required form to a customs officer, who must be at least of the rank of Assistant Commissioner, within a specified number of days from the date of arrival.
Baggage: This clause sets out the formal requirements for declaring items brought by passengers, including unaccompanied baggage.
Passengers are permitted to import unaccompanied baggage only once per calendar year.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: A customs officer with a rank not lower than an Assistant Commissioner is authorized to accept delayed baggage declarations if the passenger was unable to provide them upon arrival due to unavoidable reasons.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ৯। মৃত ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে অব্যাহতি।— এই বিধিমালায় যাহা কিছুই থাকুক না কেন, কোন বাংলাদেশী নাগরিক বিদেশে মৃত্যুবরণ করিলে তাহার ব্যাগেজ সকল প্রকার শুল্ক ও কর প্রদান হইতে অব্যাহতি পাইবে।

Passenger Baggage Allowance: In the event of the death of a Bangladeshi citizen abroad, their personal baggage is fully exempt from all customs duties and taxes.

Commercial Baggage Import: Passengers importing goods in quantities exceeding or different from those specified in the relevant baggage schedules must undergo a formal adjudication process to clear their baggage.

Clearance is contingent upon the presentation of a clearance permit from the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports and the payment of all applicable customs duties, taxes, and any imposed penalties or fines.
Chief Controller of Imports and Exports: The clearance of commercial baggage that falls outside of prescribed schedule limits requires a formal clearance permit issued by this authority.
Adjudication of Customs Cases: This process is mandatory for baggage imports that deviate from established schedule categories or quantities before the goods can be released.

১৩। (ক) আপনার নিকট মদ, মদ্যজাতীয় পানীয়, সিগারেট বা মাদক দ্রব্য আছে কি ? [উল্লেখ্য, এক কার্টন (২০০ শলাকা) সিগারেট সকল প্রকার শুল্ক ও কর পরিশোধ ব্যতিরেকে খালাসযোগ্য] : আছে / নাই
(খ) উপরের (ক) তে উল্লিখিত পরিমাণের বেশী থাকিলে উহার বিবরণঃ বর্ণনা, পরিমাণ
১৪। (ক) আপনার নিকট অনু্যন ৫,০০০ (পাঁচ হাজার) মার্কিন ডলারের বা উহার সমপরিমাণ অর্থের অধিক কোন বৈদেশিক মুদ্রা আছে কি? : আছে / নাই
(খ) উপরের (ক) তে উল্লিখিত পরিমাণের বেশী থাকিলে উহার বিবরণ এফএমজে ফরমে ঘোষণা করিতে হইবে : বর্ণনা, পরিমাণ
১৫। (ক) আপনার ব্যাগেজে শুল্ক বা কর আরোপযোগ্য কোন পণ্য আছে কি? : আছে / নাই
(খ) ব্যাগেজে শুল্ক বা কর আরোপযোগ্য পণ্য থাকিলে উহার বিবরণ : বর্ণনা, পরিমাণ

National Board of Revenue: The Board is the authority responsible for prescribing the official baggage declaration form used by passengers arriving in Bangladesh.
Passenger Baggage Declaration Form: This form is a mandatory document for incoming passengers to declare items such as personal effects, precious metals, currency, and dutiable goods.
It incorporates specific rules regarding duty-free allowances for gold, silver, tobacco, and foreign currency thresholds as referenced in the customs baggage regulations.
Passenger Baggage Allowance: The regulations specify duty-free limits for gold and silver ornaments, as well as cigarettes, with requirements to pay duties on quantities exceeding these specified amounts.
Passengers are required to declare foreign currency exceeding a set limit and must provide additional documentation for amounts beyond that threshold.
Superintendent of Customs: The Superintendent of Customs acts as the authorized official to process and verify the baggage declaration submitted by the passenger.

Passenger Baggage Purchase Form: This form is designated for the purchase of goods by passengers as specified under the relevant rules.
It requires the passenger to declare items within a specific number of working days following their arrival.
The form includes fields for passenger identification, travel details, and a record of the items intended for purchase from specified duty-free centers.
Customs Officer: The officer is responsible for determining the availability and eligibility of goods declared by the passenger based on their actual baggage and applicable regulations.
National Board of Revenue: The Board holds the authority to issue these regulatory documents and orders regarding customs procedures.
Baggage Inspector: The inspector is required to provide their name and signature on the purchase form to verify the process.
Assistant Commissioner of Customs: The designated commissioner is required to provide their name and signature on the purchase form to finalize the authorization process.
